name: controlled P2plus input/readout audit
scope: reuse six-source cached depth/features/labels; train-only calibration; current cave/market diagnostic not independent

variants.dense_P2: original dense depth, median focus, old threshold0.13; exact original score implementation
variants.sampled_dense_focus: P2plus actual centered log-depth16x37, original dense median focus retained for sampling-only diagnostic; bilinear score upsample; threshold0.13; extra dense reference therefore NOT information-matched
variants.sampled_query_fixed: same sampled feature plus exact area-weighted scalar focus query; only sampled input/mask information; bilinear score/linear-margin logits upsample; original threshold0.13
variants.sampled_matched_rule: same input-only score as sampled_query_fixed; threshold selected from original P2 candidate grid only on four training sources
variants.dense_mean_rule: dense centered log-depth with same mean focus aggregation, no scalar spatial decimation; train-only same-grid threshold calibration; diagnostic for sole dense-grid candidate

threshold_selection: source-equal train Macro-F1, fixed3 denominator, tie smallest threshold; save before diagnostic dev evaluation
input_statistics: weighted focus query minus dense log median
weighted focus query minus dense focus log mean
weights assigned to patch centers outside geometric focus mask
GT relative relation disagreement against dense baseline, per source and region

candidate.effects_disclosed: grid factor removes center decimation, makes focus pooling pixel-exact, and removes patch-logit upsample; cannot isolate these three linked grid effects from corrected training alone
candidate.gate: confirm deterministic support mismatch or measurable train sampling/reference loss before training; no dev-performance selection

independent_policy: freeze candidate and comparison before opening new source outputs; select2 unused Sintel families from prior reserved-not-selected list via SHA256(20261029:P2plus-audit-independent:family), first lexical sequence with frames1..25 in official RGB/depth archives; no DAVIS held-out access
secondary: Balanced Accuracy, boundary/interior, per-class CM; no visual quality inference
new_model_inference: none for initial audit; only same VGGT frozen extraction for newly selected independent sources after freeze
